display_long_description:
# 🌀Warp Through Time! The Toy Planet Update is HERE🌀
A new stage "Toy Planet" has been added!
This time, you've been swallowed by a rift in space-time! Climb your way through a distorted, low-gravity temporal void!

This stage is pure chaos, with multiple worlds colliding through time and space!
The "Prehistoric Area", where dinosaurs are ready to strike at any moment,
the "Pixel Area", where everything is blocky and pixelated,
and the "Temporal Area," which whisks you away to the next alternate world (and hopefully home)!

The Temporal Area features a new gimmick where footholds and walls only appear right around you!

Can you reach the exit of the space-time and climb to victory?

[media]

# 💪Your hands are crowbars—ready to start climbing💪

In Crowbar Climber, use your crowbars to make your way up!
Face hooks, planks, and gears using only your arms.
Can you beat the game before you run out of energy?

[media]

# 🧗‍♂️Master the art of climbing through physics!🧗‍♀️

Control your environment and body using a crowbar that reacts to every move.
Grab hooks at the last second, launch yourself with powerful swings, and cling to ledges in creative ways.

[media]

# 📸Share your gameplay videos with friends!🎥

Record both first-person and third-person perspectives, just like in the promo video.

Show off your crowbar-climbing skills to friends or share on social media.
